meta.name: analogical-transfer
meta.description: Systematic structure-mapping from source to target domain (Gentner). Identify relational correspondences and transfer higher-order constraints.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将源领域结构映射到目标领域，发现关系对应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同领域间系统化转移知识结构
copy.tagline_en: Map source domain structures to target domain, identify relational correspondences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically transfer knowledge structures between domains

howto.what: Claude会运用结构映射理论，系统地寻找源领域与目标领域的深层关系相似性，将抽象原理迁移并适配到新领域，优先关系相似性而非表面相似性。
howto.when: 当你要求进行类比推理、跨领域知识迁移或举一反三时。

say.text: 请用太阳系结构类比来解释原子模型。
say.note: Claude会提取关系映射并产出类比结论。

say.text: 从生物学进化过程推导一种新的商业竞争策略。
say.note: Claude会寻找结构相似性并迁移原理。

say.text: 把音乐和弦的和谐关系映射到团队协作中。
say.note: Claude会进行结构匹配并适配。

howto.what_en: Claude systematically maps relational structures from a source domain to a target domain following structure-mapping theory, prioritizing deep relational similarity over surface features, and adapts transferred principles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request analogical reasoning, cross-domain knowledge transfer, or applying patterns from one field to another.

say_en.text: Explain atomic model using solar system analogy.
say_en.note: Claude extracts relational mappings and outputs analogy.

say_en.text: Derive a new business strategy from biological evolution.
say_en.note: Claude finds structural similarities and transfers principles.

say_en.text: Map musical harmony relationships to team collaboration.
say_en.note: Claude performs structural matching and adaptation.
